name: Parallel CPU/GPU Voxelization
definition: Parallel implementation of the voxelization process using OpenMP (CPU) and CUDA (GPU) to accelerate the iteration over tetrahedra and voxel points.
summary: Parallel CPU/GPU Voxelization accelerates tetrahedral mesh voxelization by distributing work across CPU and GPU cores, maximizing throughput for high-density meshes while avoiding overhead penalties on smaller datasets.
